I read `camera-api.d.ts`, but it doesn't settle any of the four questions. Its only free-camera control, `attachFreeControl(camera, canvas, scene)`, has no options and no documented input behavior. The `attachControl` pointer mappings belong to the arc-rotate camera, not the free camera. So I've recorded all four answers as `null` (unknown) rather than guessing.

FILE: app/notes/pointer-lock.json
```json
{
  "lockedNoButton": null,
  "lockedButtonHeld": null,
  "rightDrag": null,
  "touchDrag": null
}
```

I didn't write this file to disk. I don't have file-writing tools in this session, so the block above is the content for you to save at that path. I also couldn't check the library source or run anything, since the library isn't on this machine. To get real answers, read the implementation of `attachFreeControl` in the Babylon Lite 1.39.0 package, or test each case in a browser. The declarations show that the free camera has `_yaw`, `_pitch`, and `angularSensitivity`, so it does have some look-rotation logic, but that doesn't tell us which input events drive it.
